Send a request to find out the current status of your payment after it has been authorized using the events action link. 

 **Important:** 

  Only use this for recovery purposes, for example when your authorization request has timed out or you are unable to locate a payment through our [Payments Queries API](/products/payment-queries). If the query returns results, you can manage the payment using the next action links returned in the response of your GET request.
